name: Every Island Event Can Happen
description: The Bitter Brown Beans (both versions: Science below level 2, or 2 or more), The Ancient Tablet (both versions: Science below 2; Science 2 or more and Alchemy below 3) and The Medical Emergency (Medicine 2 or more) can now happen at any technology level, even with everything researched. "Focus research on tablet" still raises Alchemy by 1 level, up to 3; at level 3 the event still happens, shows its own text, and the level stays at 3. The Ghostly Dreams keep their Nature / Magic need. Every other requirement (the villagers an event needs, puzzles, buildings, food, graves, room), how often events come and how one is chosen stay as in the normal game. **Needs no other patch.**
behavior_changes: The Bitter Brown Beans (taste or dye) and The Ancient Tablet (laundry or decoration) qualify at every Science level; the always-applied record check of their shared condition still runs.
The Bitter Brown Beans (brew or fertilizer) qualifies at every Science level.
The Ancient Tablet (research or display) qualifies at every Science and Alchemy level.
The Medical Emergency qualifies at every Medicine level.
"Focus research on tablet" is the game's own raise: +1 level, never past 3.
explicit_non_changes: Only technology-level requirements are dropped; every other requirement of every event is the game's own.
The time between island events, the family weights, the re-rolls and every event's text are unchanged.
The Ghostly Dreams still need Nature level 1 / Magic level 1.
evidence_status: static exact-build evidence (every write guarded by its stock bytes) and emulated conditions and raises at every technology level in all three patch modes; not yet seen in a running game

patches.purpose: The Bitter Brown Beans (taste or dye) / The Ancient Tablet (laundry or decoration), condition 0x4157E0: no villager -> ret (eax 0, as stock); a villager -> 0x415817 instead of the Science read at 0x415800
the same condition: alignment nops -> xor eax, eax; jmp 0x41580C -- level 0 into the shared level test (the always-applied safety patch's record check there still runs): Science below 2 dropped
The Bitter Brown Beans (brew or fertilizer), condition 0x4159B0: Science > 1 (cmp eax, 1 / setg) -> cmp eax, -128: any level
The Ancient Tablet (research or display), condition 0x415C40: Alchemy below 3 (cmp eax, 3 / jl) -> cmp eax, 127: any level ("Focus research on tablet" still adds 1 only below 3, 0x426FDD)
The Ancient Tablet (research or display): Science 2 or more (cmp eax, 2 / setge) -> cmp eax, -128
The Medical Emergency, condition 0x4171D0: Medicine 2 or more (cmp eax, 2 / setge) -> cmp eax, -128
